requiredSecrets.name: VPS_HOST
requiredSecrets.reason: IP or DNS name of the VPS target.

requiredSecrets.name: VPS_PORT
requiredSecrets.reason: SSH port used by ssh, scp and ssh-keyscan.

requiredSecrets.name: VPS_SSH_KEY
requiredSecrets.reason: Private SSH key for GitHub Actions deploy user.

requiredSecrets.name: PRODUCTION_ENV_FILE
requiredSecrets.reason: Full production environment file copied to VPS shared .env.

optionalSecrets.name: VPS_DEPLOY_MODE
optionalSecrets.reason: Optional auto/docker/systemd override. Defaults to auto.

optionalSecrets.name: VITE_API_BASE_URL
optionalSecrets.reason: Optional API URL embedded into systemd frontend build.

optionalSecrets.name: VITE_PUBLIC_WEB_URL
optionalSecrets.reason: Optional public web URL embedded into systemd frontend build.

notRequiredSecrets.name: DOCKER_REGISTRY_TOKEN
notRequiredSecrets.reason: Current workflows build locally and do not push container images to a registry.
